location_name: 93 and 118 nautical miles northeast of Kuala Terengganu
summary: On 23 January 2021 the Terengganu MMEA patrol ship KM Langkawi detained two Vietnamese fishing boats and their 16 crew 93 and 118 nautical miles northeast of Kuala Terengganu for fishing without licences in Malaysian waters, seizing boats, gear and catch worth RM3 million. It was one of a continuing series of MMEA detentions of Vietnamese boats in 2021.
